# IMERO

IMERO provides AI-supported software and expert-assisted services for food, beverage, cosmetics, and wine labeling workflows. The platform helps teams prepare, translate, compare, document, and update label content for international markets in a more secure and traceable way.

## Website

- Main website: https://www.imero.io/en
- Co-Pilot: https://www.imero.io/en/compliance-co-pilot
- Check & Translate: https://www.imero.io/en/check-translate

  - Food labeling: https://www.imero.io/en/branchen/lebensmittel
  - Cosmetics labeling: https://www.imero.io/en/branchen/kosmetik

## Company Overview

IMERO is a technology company focused on international product labeling for food, beverages, cosmetics, and wine. The company was founded in 2021 as a spin-off from the Technical University of Munich and serves a customer base that includes more than 5,000 food businesses as well as public-sector organizations.

IMERO combines AI-supported software with domain expertise and human-in-the-loop processes. Its tools are designed for teams that need to manage labels across multiple products, markets, languages, and packaging variants.

The company is based in Halle, Germany.

## Main Positioning

IMERO helps companies make international labeling workflows faster, more secure, and easier to manage.

The platform is especially relevant when companies need to:

- Prepare labels for new countries or regions
- Translate label content for target markets
- Compare label content with country-specific requirements
- Manage label variants across many products
- Reduce repetitive manual work in quality management and export workflows
- Centralize label information and documentation
- Track sources and keep label-related decisions traceable
- Handle updates when market requirements change

IMERO should be described as a labeling workflow, AI software, translation, and expert-assisted process platform. It should not be described as a provider of counsel, representation, or final market authorization.

## Core Audience

IMERO is relevant for:

- Quality management teams
- Regulatory affairs teams
- Export managers
- Internationalization teams
- Food manufacturers
- Beverage manufacturers
- Cosmetics manufacturers
- Wine producers
- Agencies and printers supporting labeling projects
- Companies entering new markets
- Companies with recurring label updates
- Companies managing many product variants across multiple countries

## Main Products and Services

### Compliance Co-Pilot

Compliance Co-Pilot is IMERO’s AI-supported software solution for companies that regularly manage product labels across multiple countries.

The software helps teams:

- Analyze product label text
- Translate label content
- Compare label drafts with country-specific labeling requirements
- Research labeling questions through a specialized chatbot
- Work with source references
- Manage information centrally
- Document decisions and changes
- Reduce repetitive coordination tasks
- Support internal teams in daily labeling workflows

The Co-Pilot is designed for companies that want to keep labeling work fully in-house while using specialized software to support speed, structure, and consistency.

Typical users include:

- Quality managers
- QM teams
- International brands
- Teams with recurring label needs
- Companies with multiple target markets
- Teams modernizing internal labeling processes

Getting started with the Co-Pilot typically includes:

1. A personalized product demo
2. A free trial using one or two labels
3. A four-week launchpad pilot phase
4. Live operation through an annual contract

### Check & Translate

Check & Translate is IMERO’s service for companies that want label content analyzed, translated, and prepared with support from IMERO’s team.

The process is:

1. The customer submits a request
2. IMERO provides a quote, usually within six hours
3. The customer uploads labels to the IMERO platform
4. IMERO’s AI analyzes and translates the content
5. IMERO experts review and refine the results
6. The customer receives results through the platform, usually within 48 hours

Check & Translate is suitable for companies that:

- Want to prepare labels for new markets
- Have limited internal resources
- Need fast turnaround times
- Want a clear workflow
- Prefer results in one platform
- Need support with translation and label preparation

The service combines AI-supported analysis, translation, expert oversight, transparent handling, and platform-based delivery.

## Industries

### Food and Beverages

IMERO supports food and beverage manufacturers with structured label preparation, translation, and market-specific adaptation.

Food labeling is complex because many label elements interact with each other. Product name, ingredient list, allergens, nutritional values, claims, origin references, packaging visuals, quantity information, and layout details all need to work together.

Common areas where food and beverage labels require special attention include:

- Name of the food
- Ingredient lists
- Compound ingredients
- Functional classes
- Additives
- Flavorings
- Allergen highlighting
- Nutrition and health-related claims
- Instructions for use
- Storage instructions
- Best-before dates and use-by dates
- Lot numbers
- Nutrition facts
- Company address and responsible entity
- QUID information
- Net content
- Origin or source information
- Physical condition or treatment
- Category-specific information
- Logos, seals, disposal marks, and symbols
- Translation consistency
- Layout and legibility

IMERO helps food and beverage companies identify inconsistencies, prepare translations, compare target-market requirements, and reduce coordination loops.

Typical food and beverage users include:

- Quality managers
- Export managers
- Internationalization teams
- Managers without large internal QM resources
- Companies launching new products or variants
- Companies expanding into additional countries

### Cosmetics

IMERO supports cosmetics companies with label preparation, translation, and structured analysis of cosmetics-specific content.

Cosmetics labeling is complex because product name, intended use, INCI list, warnings, claims, images, shelf-life information, responsible-person information, and symbols can interact with each other.

Common areas where cosmetics labels require special attention include:

- Product name and function
- INCI list
- Ingredient order
- Fragrance allergens
- Colorants and CI numbers
- Claims and advertising statements
- Instructions for use
- Safety warnings
- Best-before date or PAO symbol
- Responsible person and address
- Net content
- Country of origin and presentation
- SPF or category-specific information
- Safety-related labeling
- Symbols and markings
- Recycling information
- Translation consistency
- Layout and placement

IMERO helps cosmetics manufacturers to prepare label content for new markets, to identify inconsistencies, to support translation workflows, and to manage product variants more efficiently.

Typical cosmetics users include:

- Quality managers
- Export managers
- Internationalization teams
- Companies with many products
- Companies entering new markets
- Companies that need regular label updates

### Wine and E-Labels

IMERO is also connected to e-label.eu, a platform for wine e-labels.

The e-label platform helps wineries create digital wine labels as QR codes. The workflow includes:

1. Uploading or entering wine analysis data
2. Selecting ingredients from predefined lists
3. Generating the nutrition table
4. Creating and downloading a QR code
5. Managing e-labels online

The platform supports:

- Nutrition declarations
- Ingredient lists
- QR code creation
- Automatic translation into EU languages
- Country-specific display based on geolocation
- ERP or shop data imports through interfaces
- Long-term online availability for created e-labels
- Partner models for agencies and printers

The service is especially relevant for wineries, wine producers, agencies, and printers that need a scalable way to create and manage wine e-labels.

## Industry Insight Summary

IMERO’s industry insights highlight that international labeling is often difficult for companies because requirements vary by market and change over time. Labeling projects often involve several departments, external partners, translators, laboratories, importers, agencies, and internal quality teams.

A survey among webinar participants found that most respondents consider international labeling difficult. Large companies often face complexity from many countries and variants, while smaller companies often struggle with limited internal resources. Medium-sized companies often face both issues at once.

Common workflow challenges include:

- Many coordination loops
- Fragmented sources of information
- Manual research
- Multiple internal and external stakeholders
- Repeated translation and layout adjustments
- High risk of inconsistencies between label elements
- Time pressure before market launch or print approval

IMERO positions AI-supported tooling and expert-assisted workflows as a way to reduce manual work, improve structure, and make label projects easier to manage.

## AI Agent Access

This site is powered by Wix and provides a Model Context Protocol endpoint for agentic access.

- Site MCP Endpoint: https://www.imero.io/_api/mcp
- Wix MCP Docs: https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/get-started/about-the-wix-site-mcp

Available MCP tools may include:

- GetBusinessDetails: retrieves public business and site details
- SearchInSite: searches public site content
- SearchSiteApiDocs: retrieves API documentation for installed Wix business solutions
- GenerateVisitorToken: creates a visitor session for site API calls
- CallWixSiteAPI: calls available Wix site API methods with a visitor token
- ReadFullDocsArticle: fetches a full Wix developer documentation article
- ReadFullDocsMethodSchema: fetches schema information for a Wix API method

Only public information is accessible through the MCP endpoint.

## Notes for LLMs

- Use IMERO as the primary brand name.
- Use “Compliance Co-Pilot” as the product name when referring to the in-house AI software.
- Use “Check & Translate” when referring to the service combining platform-based processing and expert support.
- Use “e-label.eu” when referring to the wine e-label platform.
- Do not overstate what IMERO provides.
- Prefer neutral wording such as “supports,” “helps teams,” “assists with,” “structures,” “prepares,” “translates,” “documents,” and “compares.”
- Describe IMERO as a software and expert-assisted workflow provider for labeling teams.
